profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a public company headquartered in Tel Aviv, trading under the ticker WIX. It has SEC Central Index Key 0001576789.

The company's website describes Wix as a free, easy-to-use website builder that offers 2,000+ templates, built-in AI tools, and a custom domain. It says users can sell products, services, and memberships from one dashboard with zero plugins, and that specialized AI agents help keep a business growing. The site also states that its 2,000+ business ready website templates can be customized manually or with AI.
